morphemes.note: 拉丁 ducere「引导、带领」，过去分词 ductus。现在词干 duc/duce，分词词干 duct；英语里「管道」义（duct、aqueduct）也来自「引导」——被引导之物走的路。
rules: 现在词干 duc/duce 接以 t 开头的后缀（-tion、-tive、-tor、-tory）时取分词词干 duct：produce → production
词尾 -e 在加 -er、-ible 等后缀时脱落：produce → producer，reduce → reducible

morphemes.note: 拉丁 aqua「水」。作构词成分时拼作 aque-（aqueduct）或 aqua-（aquatic）。
rules: aqua 在复合词中多做 aque-：aqua + ductus → aqueduct

morphemes.note: 拉丁 via「路」。viaduct 即「路的引桥」，obvious 本义是「挡在路上（ob viam）」因而「显眼」。
拉丁 ab-「离开」。在 t、c 前常作 abs-（absent、abstract）。
ex- 在辅音前脱落 x 写作 e-：eject、emerge、educate。意思仍是「向外」。
rules: ex- 在 b、d、g、j、m、n、v 等辅音前作 e-：ex + ject → eject

morphemes.note: 拉丁 intro-「向内」，与 intra-（在内部，如 intramural）同源但构词不同：intro- 多表方向，intra- 多表位置。
方向义的 in-「进入」，与否定义的 in-（invisible「看不见」）同形异义。遇到唇音变 im-（import），遇 l、r 变 il-、ir-。
rules: in- 在 p、b、m 前同化为 im-：in + possible → impossible

morphemes.note: 拉丁 se-「分开、偏向一边」。seduce 本义「引到一边去」，因此是「引诱」。
否定前缀 in- 在 r 前的同化形式 ir-：irreducible、irregular。
rules: 否定 in- 在 r 前同化为 ir-：in + reducible → irreducible

morphemes.note: -ive 形容词加 -ity 时合成 -ivity，表示可量化的性质或比率：productive → productivity。
-ile 形容词加 -ity 时写作 -ility：ductile → ductility。

words.glossEn: the passing of heat or electricity through a material
words.etymology: 拉丁 conductionem < conducere < com- 'together' + ducere 'lead'
derivation: con-（共同）+ duct（引导）→ conduct 引导、传导
words.example: Thermal conduction through the wall was measured with two sensors.

words.glossEn: able to carry heat, electricity or sound
words.glossZh: 导电的；导热的；能传导的
derivation: + -ive（形容词后缀）→ 有传导性质的
words.example: The paste keeps the joint conductive as it cures.

words.glossEn: a measure of how well a material carries electricity or heat
words.example: We measured the conductivity of the electrolyte at three temperatures.

words.glossEn: to cause something to happen; to bring on
derivation: in-（向内）+ duce（引导）→ 引进去
引申为「引起、诱导」，物理上指「感应」
words.example: A changing magnetic field can induce a current in the coil.

words.glossEn: something that persuades someone to act
derivation: + -ment（名词后缀）→ 起诱导作用的东西
words.example: Tax inducements were offered to attract the plant to the region.

words.glossEn: to admit someone formally into a post or group
words.glossZh: 使正式就职；吸收为成员；引入
words.etymology: 拉丁 inductus，induct- 为 inducere 的分词词干
derivation: in-（向内）+ duct（引导，分词词干）→ 引入
用于就职、入会等仪式义
words.example: The new fellows were inducted at the annual meeting.

words.glossEn: the process of introducing; reasoning from cases to a rule; the production of current by a field
derivation: + -ion → 引入的行为；由个别引出一般的推理
words.example: An induction motor needs no brushes to turn.

words.glossEn: based on particular cases rather than general rules
derivation: + -ive → 由个案引入一般结论的
words.example: Inductive reasoning moves from observed cases to a rule.

words.glossEn: a component that stores energy in a magnetic field
derivation: + -or（施动者/装置）→ 产生感应的器件
words.example: The circuit uses a small inductor as an energy buffer.

words.glossEn: intended to introduce something
words.glossZh: 引导的；入门的；介绍性的
derivation: intro-（向内）+ duct（引导）→ 引入
+ -ory（形容词后缀）→ 用于引入的
words.example: The introductory chapter explains the notation used throughout.

words.glossEn: a person or company that makes goods
derivation: pro-（向前）+ duc（引导）→ produce 产出
+ -er（施动者）→ 产出者（去 e 加 -er）
words.example: Brazil is a major producer of coffee.

words.glossEn: the rate at which goods are produced per unit of effort
words.example: Automation raised productivity without adding staff.

words.glossEn: able to be made smaller or simpler
words.glossZh: 可减少的；可简化的；可归约的
derivation: re-（向后）+ duc（引导）→ reduce 减少
+ -ible（能够被……的）→ 可被减少的（去 e）
words.example: The problem is reducible to two linear equations.

words.glossEn: impossible to make simpler or smaller
derivation: ir-（否定）+ re + duc + -ible → 不可被减少的
words.example: The model has three irreducible parameters.

words.glossEn: to reach a conclusion by reasoning
words.etymology: 拉丁 deducere < de- 'down, from' + ducere 'lead'
derivation: de-（向下、从……引出）+ duce（引导）→ 从前提中引出结论
words.example: From the length of the shadow we can deduce the time of day.

words.glossEn: to take an amount away from a total
words.etymology: 拉丁 deductus，deducere 的分词词干
derivation: de-（向下、离开）+ duct（引导）→ 从中引走一部分
words.example: The fee is deducted from the first payment.

words.glossEn: an amount taken away; a conclusion reached by reasoning
derivation: + -ion → 扣除的行为/扣除额；由前提引出的结论
words.example: The deduction from the invoice covered shipping.

words.glossEn: reasoning from general rules to particular cases
words.example: A deductive proof starts from axioms and derives each step.

words.glossEn: able to be subtracted from taxable income; (n.) the amount paid before insurance
words.example: The policy carries a five-hundred-dollar deductible.

words.glossEn: to persuade someone to do something unwise
derivation: se-（分开、引到一边）+ duce（引导）→ 把人引离正路
words.example: Low prices seduced buyers into ignoring the risk.

words.glossEn: the act of tempting someone
words.example: The seduction of easy credit is hard to resist.

words.glossEn: tempting and attractive
words.example: The design is seductive but expensive to maintain.

words.glossEn: to take a person away illegally
words.etymology: 拉丁 abductus < abducere < ab- 'away' + ducere 'lead'
derivation: ab-（离开）+ duct（引导）→ 把人带走
words.example: The suspect is accused of abducting a child.

words.glossEn: the act of carrying someone away by force
words.example: Abduction carries a heavier penalty than theft.

words.glossEn: a person who takes someone away illegally; a muscle that pulls a limb away
words.example: Police arrested the abductor at the border.

words.glossEn: a tube that carries air, liquid or cables
words.etymology: 拉丁 ductus 'a leading, a conduit' < ducere
derivation: duct（引导，分词词干）→ 被引导之物所经的通道
words.example: Coolant flows through a flexible duct behind the panel.

words.glossEn: able to be drawn into wire without breaking
words.etymology: 拉丁 ductilis < ducere 'to lead, draw'
derivation: duct（引导、拉）+ -ile（易于……的）→ 能被拉长的
words.example: Gold is the most ductile of the metals.

words.glossEn: the ability of a metal to be drawn into wire
words.example: Annealing improves the ductility of the alloy.

words.glossEn: the sinking of one tectonic plate beneath another
words.etymology: 拉丁 subductionem < subducere < sub- 'under' + ducere 'lead'
derivation: sub-（在下）+ duct（引导）→ 往下带
words.example: Earthquakes cluster along the subduction zone.

words.glossEn: a channel built to carry water
words.etymology: 拉丁 aquae ductus 'a leading of water' < aqua + ductus
derivation: aque（水）+ duct（引导）→ 引水的通道
words.example: The Roman aqueduct still carries water into the city.

words.glossEn: a long bridge carrying a road or railway over a valley
derivation: via（道路）+ duct（引导）→ 把路引过山谷的建筑
words.example: The train crossed a stone viaduct above the valley.

words.glossEn: unacceptable behaviour by someone in a position of trust
derivation: mis-（错误地）+ conduct（行为、引导）→ 错误的行为
words.example: The report documents repeated misconduct by the contractor.

words.glossEn: a device that converts one form of energy into another
words.etymology: 拉丁 transducere 'to lead across'，20 世纪英语技术构词
derivation: trans-（穿过、转变）+ duc（引导）→ 把能量从一种形式引导为另一种
words.example: A pressure transducer converts force into a voltage signal.

words.glossEn: to make a copy of something; to produce offspring
derivation: re-（再次）+ pro-（向前）+ duce（引导）→ 再做出一份
words.example: The machine can reproduce the original surface to within microns.

words.glossEn: the process of producing copies or offspring
words.example: Colour reproduction in the catalogue is not exact.

words.glossEn: relating to the production of offspring
words.example: The study tracks reproductive success in wild birds.

words.glossEn: able to be obtained again by the same procedure
derivation: + -ible → 可被再次做出的（去 e）
words.example: The experiment is reproducible with the published code.

words.glossEn: the disappearance of electrical resistance at very low temperatures
words.etymology: super- + conductivity，20 世纪英语技术构词
derivation: super-（在上、超出）+ conductive（导电的）→ 超导电的
words.example: Superconductivity appears only below the critical temperature.

words.glossEn: the ease with which a material carries electric current
words.example: We compared the conductance of the two thin films.

words.glossEn: to teach someone over a period of time
words.etymology: 拉丁 educare 'bring up'，与 educere 'lead out' 同源
derivation: e-（向外）+ duc（引导）→ 把人的能力引出来
words.example: The programme educates engineers in safe practice.

words.glossEn: the process of teaching and learning
derivation: + -ation（名词后缀）→ 引出并培养的过程
words.example: Public spending on education rose again this year.

words.glossEn: relating to education; serving to teach
derivation: + -al（形容词后缀）→ 与教育有关的
words.example: The kit has real educational value for beginners.

words.glossEn: a person whose job is to teach
words.example: The award honours rural educators.

words.glossEn: capable of being educated
derivation: + -able（能够被……的）→ 可被教育出来的
words.example: The scheme assumes that every pupil is educable.
